description: Elections Commission - T. P. G. A. Nilmini Senevirathna Elected as Vice Chairman of the Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in the office of Vice Chairman of a local authority (Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official to fill a vacant position, which falls squarely under the Elections classification (Type 7).
